name: Calm
oneliner: Warm, quiet polish for cafes and wellness. Bed and voice only, no hits.
description: Your voice, cleaned and evened out over a soft room tone. Gentle short whooshes on cuts, nothing else.
prompt: Sound pass, preset calm. Set EDL to the EDL the draft was rendered from ($W/edl.story.json after a story pass, else $W/edl.json). Run it on the finished picture (after captions, before QA): python3 scripts/rr.py run -- python3 engines/sound.py "$W/captioned.mp4" --out "$W/sound.mp4" --edl "$EDL" --captions "$W/draft.words.json" --preset calm. Voice polish (highpass 80 Hz, de-esser, 3:1 compression at -18 dB) over a pink room-tone bed at about -45 LUFS; a short, soft whoosh at -14 dB under the voice on each internal cut; nothing at the hook and no caption pops. Ends at -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP, video stream copied. If M2 is in the mix, these whooshes replace M2's. Do NOT add impacts, risers or pops, and do NOT run a second S card.
